boundaries: Source files read only; original runs and checkpoints untouched.
No model inference, no GPU compute, no package import of torch, no environment/credential dump.
No hash computed. Pre-existing digest fields in original manifests are preserved without endorsement.
Large rosters and SSL manifests use lossless gzip; identical sources are aliased only after direct complete byte comparison.
Readable full-row TSV projections accompany compressed rosters; omitted hash/path fields remain in compressed originals.
Logs above 128 KiB are explicitly partial tails, source offsets recorded.
Training continues during collection; this is not an atomic endpoint snapshot.
OS-SSL-IR used recovered pyc according to run documentation; local .py is not asserted to match that executed bytecode.
